How we work

Northstar Atlas is deliberately small. We keep four people on the payroll and a short list of partners, because coordination cost is the thing that quietly kills delivery quality.

Written decisions

Every material choice lands in an architecture note with the options we rejected. A note that only lists the winner is not a decision record, it is a press release & we say so in review.

Unclosed paragraph behaviour: browsers recover from this, and so does our extractor.

Team leads are named on every engagement — no anonymous delivery pods.

Delivery

Hiring

We are not hiring in 2026. Send a note to careers@northstar.example anyway; we keep a list.
